name: sparx — Law Firm (Modern)
tagline: A sharp, modern template for business & litigation firms — book consultations from day one.
description: A sharp, modern business & litigation law-firm site — a midnight-slate palette, a confident blue accent and a precise modern sans. Installs a working consultation-booking flow: real consult types (litigation, formation, M&A, IP, employment), three partner attorneys booked by name with their own hours, and a credited-deposit policy. Ships as "Meridian Law Group", a boutique with big-firm reach.
